That would have nothing to do with it - as you were already told, the error has to do with sprites, not anything with trying to wrap words in a message box. Your scene is updating and trying to update a sprite that was added to its children but doesn't actually exist.
Also, the first line of the error tells you exactly where "clamp" is found - line 6170 of rpg_core.
The VPlayer plugin is both in the list and has to do with creating images (that's the thing that lets you add GIFs, right?). Does the game work if you turn that plugin off, save your project, and start a new game?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Then you need to do some basic troubleshooting with your project.
Turn off
all
plugins, verify that works. If it doesn't, then you've broken something either by putting in some script calls, or you have an event command or something that's referencing a picture and you changed the filename or deleted that picture.
If it does work with no plugins active, turn them back on until you find which one is causing the problem.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
jbgs said:
It says that property "clamp" is undefined,
Click to expand...
no, it does not.
with error messages it is extremely important what they truly say and not just read the wrong words.
it says "cannot read property clamp of undefined."
That means it is missing the "parent" of clamp, not that clamp itself is undefined.
so you would have to look for the thing that clamp is supposed to be a part of, because that is what is undefined. And that is also why your search for clamp went wrong...
Perhaps you can understand it better with a more practical example:
let's say for displaying something you need to know the width of a picture. that would usually be picture.width
and if you have no picture and try to find its width, the computer would answer "cannot read property width of undefined", meaning that the picture itself is undefined or missing
